top_signals.title: 9 Days to Midterm Elections, Big Tech Earnings
top_signals.summary: The news doesn’t stop when markets close. Hosts David Gura, Christina Ruffini and Lisa Mateo bring clarity, context and a bit of humor to the weekend’s biggest headlines, LIVE from New York. Joined by MetLife Investment Management Chief Market Strategist Drew Matus, Financial Times Associate Editor and “Sea Change” Author Rana Foroohar, Former Prime Minister of Israel Ehud Olmert, Texas Rep. Dan Crenshaw, Former US Ambassador to Israel Daniel Shapiro, CBS News, White House & Political Correspondent Ed O’Keefe and Puck Washington Author Abby Livingston. (Source: Bloomberg)
